notes.title: Special Promotion
notes.notes:
A special promotional discount of 25% on 'Dear Mom' for a limited period of time, go grab it as soon as possible. And do let us know about your thoughts on the game.

Thank you so much for playing! Have awesome experiences :)

notes.title: Added Steam Achievements
notes.notes:
This update has added 9 Steam Achievements to the game, as requested by many people. 
Thank you for playing my game. I hope you experience something incredible.

notes.title: Fixed irritating bugs
notes.notes:
I received a few constructive feedbacks for this game, many loved the game as it is. It's my first ever game, which I tried building up in around 2 months. There were a few bugs which was making the game irritable. I fixed those, and also, did a few UI changes.

I hope the message gets delivered the way this shot game intends to.
